description: Minimal grant for the remote SK Music SPA loaded in the main window. The SPA reports playback and requests the app menu purely by EMITTING events (sk-np-report / sk-state-report / sk-menu) and by LISTENING for pushes — a remote origin can't invoke app commands regardless (Tauri denies app commands to remote content), so it only needs core event emit/listen/unlisten. The prior core:default + autostart:default + notification:default handed the remote page tray/menu/window/autostart/notification power it never uses; the tray, autostart toggle and track toasts are all driven Rust-side, which bypasses the webview ACL.
